prompts.topic: Write a Letter of Advice（给同学写一封建议信）
prompts.prompt_cn: 你的同学李华最近沉迷电脑游戏、无法专心学习,向你求助。请用英语给他写一封建议信(约80词),内容包括:① 点明你了解他的问题与感受;② 给出至少两条建议及理由;③ 以鼓励的话收尾。
prompts.prompt_en: Your classmate Li Hua spends too much time playing computer games and cannot focus on his studies. Write him a letter of advice (about 80 words). Your letter should: 1) show that you understand his problem and how he feels; 2) give at least two pieces of advice, each with a reason; 3) end with a few words of encouragement.
requirements: 用称呼开头,点明对方的问题(You wrote that …)
表示理解对方的感受(I understand that you feel …)
给出至少两条建议及理由(I think you should … / Why not … because …)
用鼓励的话和落款收尾(I am sure that … / Best wishes,)
prompts.sample_answer: Dear Li Hua, You wrote that you spend too much time playing computer games and cannot focus on your studies. I understand that you feel worried. I think you should make a daily schedule and set a fixed time for games. Why not try some new hobbies, such as sports or reading? They can help you relax in a healthier way. I am sure that if you keep trying, you will manage your time much better. Best wishes, Wang Ming
high_sentences: You wrote that you spend too much time playing computer games.（你来信说你花太多时间打游戏。）
I understand that you feel worried.（我理解你感到担心。）
I think you should make a daily schedule.（我认为你应该制定每日计划。）
Why not try some new hobbies, such as sports or reading?（何不尝试运动、阅读等新爱好?）
I am sure that if you keep trying, you will manage your time better.（我相信只要坚持,你会把时间管理得更好。）

error_pairs.note: should 是情态动词,后接动词原形,不加 to。
error_pairs.wrong: I think you should to make a plan.
error_pairs.correct: I think you should make a plan.

error_pairs.note: Why not 后直接接动词原形。
error_pairs.wrong: Why not to try a new hobby?
error_pairs.correct: Why not try a new hobby?

error_pairs.note: 修饰动词 manage 用副词 well,不用形容词 good。
error_pairs.wrong: I am sure you will manage your time good.
error_pairs.correct: I am sure you will manage your time well.

prompts.scoring_rubric: 【15 分制】A 档(13-15):结构完整(称呼/问题/理解/建议+理由/鼓励/落款)、建议≥2 条且有理由、语言准确多样;B 档(10-12):要点较全、少量语言错误;C 档(7-9):建议偏少或缺理由、句型简单、错误较多;D 档(0-6):内容不完整、结构混乱、错误多。
